import subprocess

def run_sql(container, db, sql):
    out = subprocess.check_output(["docker", "exec", container, "psql", "-U", "gpay_admin", "-d", db, "-Atc", sql], text=True)
    return out.strip()

print("=== 1. Master Bindings transform_spec ===")
print(run_sql("gpay-postgres-cdc", "cdc_dw", "SELECT id, master_schema, master_table, transform_spec::text FROM cdc_system.master_binding WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY id;"))

print("=== 2. Distinct _gpay_id check & Business Key (_source_id <-> _id) HashWindow ===")
sh_hash = run_sql("gpay-postgres-shadow", "cdc_shadow", "SELECT COUNT(*) || \x27|\x27 || COALESCE(BIT_XOR((\x27x\x27 || SUBSTR(MD5(\"_source_id\"::text || \x27|\x27 || \"_source_ts\"::text), 1, 16))::bit(64)::bigint), 0) FROM shadow_traitestpbs.payment_bills WHERE NOT COALESCE(\"_deleted\", false);")
ms1_hash = run_sql("gpay-postgres-dest", "goopay_dest", "SELECT COUNT(*) || \x27|\x27 || COALESCE(BIT_XOR((\x27x\x27 || SUBSTR(MD5(\"_id\"::text || \x27|\x27 || \"_source_ts\"::text), 1, 16))::bit(64)::bigint), 0) FROM master_payment_bill_service.payment_bills WHERE NOT COALESCE(\"_deleted\", false);")
ms2_hash = run_sql("gpay-postgres-dest", "goopay_dest", "SELECT COUNT(*) || \x27|\x27 || COALESCE(BIT_XOR((\x27x\x27 || SUBSTR(MD5(\"_id\"::text || \x27|\x27 || \"_source_ts\"::text), 1, 16))::bit(64)::bigint), 0) FROM master_payment_bill_service.payment_bills_1 WHERE NOT COALESCE(\"_deleted\", false);")
print("shadow.payment_bills (_source_id):    ", sh_hash)
print("master.payment_bills (_id):           ", ms1_hash)
print("master.payment_bills_1 (_id):         ", ms2_hash)
assert sh_hash == ms1_hash == ms2_hash, f"Hash mismatch: {sh_hash} vs {ms1_hash} vs {ms2_hash}"
print("VERIFIED: 100% Count & XorHash match across Shadow and multiple Master tables by Business Key!")
